about.Бұл коммерциялық емес жоба. Ол тұрғындар: This is a non-profit project. It helps residents understand air quality: for example, it shows where the hydrogen sulfide smell in Atyrau comes from and how wind direction and speed affect it.
about.Қала картасында әр бекеттің өлшемдері, ж: The city map shows each station’s readings, the wind and a comparison with limit values. The page about gases explains what each substance is, how it is measured and how it affects health.

about.Бұл ресми ескерту емес. Көрсетілген көзд: This is not an official warning. The sources and colours shown are a model estimate; official data on actual pollution comes from the monitoring stations themselves. Nor is this medical advice: if you feel worse, call 103 or see a doctor.

city.Есептеу — Гаусс шлейфі моделі (атмосфера: The calculation uses a Gaussian plume model (atmospheric dispersion): for each source, given that hour’s wind, atmospheric stability and release height, it estimates how much reaches each station and how fast, then compares this with the actual measurement.

Stations — the Kazhydromet map (ecodata.kz), hourly. Wind, solar radiation and cloud cover — Open-Meteo, city centre (47.11, 51.92).
city.Бір сан ≥6 сағат қатарынан өзгермесе (мә: If one value stays the same for ≥6 hours in a row (value ≥ 6) and does not move at all within ±12 hours, it is marked as “stuck” (⚠) and excluded from the analysis.
city.Тексерілді: осындай 5 мәннің бәрі AirKz: Checked: all 5 such values are not shown in the AirKz app. Stations with a CO median < 10 have a doubtful unit (possibly mg/m³) and are excluded from the analysis.
city.ҚР ДСМ-70 бұйрығы (02.08.2022), 1-қосымш: Order No. ҚР ДСМ-70 (02.08.2022), Annex 1 — maximum one-time limit. Stations report hourly values, so the comparison is approximate.
city.Көзден шыққан газ жел бойымен тарап, кең: Gas from the source spreads downwind and widens; the ground-level concentration is:
city., мұнда y — жел осінен қашықтық, H — шығ: , where y is the distance from the wind axis, H the release height and u the wind at that height.
city.• Атмосфера тұрақтылығы — Пасквилл–Гиффо: • Atmospheric stability — Pasquill–Gifford classes A–F (from wind speed, solar radiation and night-time cloud cover).
city.• Сағат ішінде жел бағыты ±15° ауытқиды: • Within an hour the wind direction is assumed to vary by ±15° (a wider plume).
city.• Биіктік маңызды: жердегі көз жақын маң: • Height matters: a ground-level source gives a high concentration nearby, especially on a calm night; the plume of a tall stack reaches the ground farther away.
city.• Тоған (Сасық сай) — пішіні OpenStreetM: • The pond (Sasyk Sai) — its shape comes from OpenStreetMap, with a 1 km grid inside; the release is split equally among the points (the nearest edge is also taken into account).
city.Құбырдан шыққан газ ауадан жылы болса, к: If the gas leaving a stack is warmer than the air, it rises (Briggs):
city.және тұрақты түнде 2,6·(F/(u·S))<sup>⅓</: and does not exceed 2.6·(F/(u·S))<sup>⅓</sup> on a stable night, otherwise 21.4·F<sup>¾</sup>/u (F < 55) or 38.7·F<sup>0.6</sup>/u. F is the buoyancy flux (stack diameter, gas velocity, difference between gas and air temperature).
city.Құбыр параметрлері — НДВ-дан (қазір АТЭЦ: Stack parameters come from the emission limits documents (currently ATPP No. 4 and No. 2); for the refinery flare the gas temperature is unknown, so no rise is calculated.
city.Ауа температурасы — көзге жақын Қазгидро: Air temperature — values from Kazhydromet stations near the source (weighted by 1/d²), or Open-Meteo if there are none. Single-level measurements are not enough to detect an inversion, so the stability class is still derived from wind, radiation and cloud cover.
city.Әр бекеттің өз фонынан (медиана) артық м: Each station’s excess over its own background (median) is taken. For each source the model works out what pattern the stations would show if that source were responsible,
city.ең кіші квадраттар әдісімен сәйкестендір: and matches it to the real pattern by least squares. The result is the share of the excess that the source explains. Below 25% — “source not identified”; 25–50% — a weak signal (the list is shown, no outline on the map). If the excess is below 3 µg/m³, no source search is done at all (ecodata rounds values to integers, so a small difference is noise).
city.Тексерілді: жасанды шығарылыммен 10 тест: Tested: 10 tests with an artificial release (the source is found; a ground-level source and a 60 m stack at the same point are told apart).
city.Көзден бекетке дейінгі қашықтық ÷ сол са: Distance from the source to the station ÷ wind speed in that hour (for the pond — from its nearest edge). A simple estimate: the air is assumed to travel in a straight line with the wind.
city.Модель «секірістерді» іздейді, ал бекет: The model looks for “jumps” and treats a constant source next to a station as background. So there is a separate check: is the station above the median of the city’s stations in ≥ 80% of the hours in the period.
city.Артық мән болған бекеттен (немесе шағым: An arrow goes from a station with an excess (or a complaint point) toward where the wind came from; the arrowhead points at the station — the wind carried the gas from the source to the station. Where the arrows meet is the possible source.
city.Бір сағатта сызықтар параллель, сондықта: Within a single hour the lines are parallel, so finding a source takes several hours during which the wind turned (3 hours by default).
city.Жел — қаланың бір нүктесінен; көздердің: Wind is from a single point in the city; the height and position of sources are assumptions (they can be edited); TCO and NCOC data are not processed.
city.Нәтиже — ықтималдық, кінәліні дәлелдеу е: The result is a probability, not proof of who is to blame.

gazdar.Ауадағы негізгі ластаушы заттар: күкіртс: The main air pollutants: hydrogen sulfide, sulfur dioxide, nitrogen dioxide and dust particles. Limit values, health effects and measurement methods.
gazdar.Газдар туралы — H₂S, SO₂, NO₂, PM2,5: About gases — H₂S, SO₂, NO₂, PM2.5
gazdar.Шекті мәндер, денсаулыққа әсері және өлш: Limit values, health effects and measurement methods.
gazdar.<p>Бекеттер не өлшейді, қалай өлшейді жә: What the stations measure, how they measure it and how it affects health
gazdar.Бекеттер ауадағы газдар мен шаңды автома: Stations continuously measure gases and dust in the air with automatic instruments and report a value every hour. Below, for each substance: how it is measured, how it affects health and what is noticeable at which level.
gazdar.<b>Өлшем бірліктері.</b> Сайтта — <b>мкг: Units. This site uses µg/m³: the mass of a substance in one cubic metre of air, in micrograms (1000 µg/m³ = 1 mg/m³). Foreign texts, especially workplace limits, often use ppm: parts of gas per million parts of air.
gazdar.Бір-біріне ауыстыру газға байланысты: мы: Conversion depends on the gas: for example, for H2S 1 ppm ≈ 1400 µg/m³, so 0.003 ppm ≈ 4 µg/m³. To avoid confusion, the limit values below are given in both units (25 °C).
gazdar.<b>Шекті мәндер</b> — ҚР ДСМ-70 бұйрығы: Limit values follow Order No. ҚР ДСМ-70 (the maximum one-time limit is for 20–30 minutes). A station gives an hourly average, so the comparison is approximate.
gazdar.Түссіз газ. Көздері: мұнай өңдеу, мұнай-: A colourless gas. Sources: oil refining, oil and gas fields, treatment plants, evaporation ponds, swamps.
gazdar.Әдетте ультракүлгін флуоресценция әдісім: Usually by ultraviolet fluorescence: SO2 in the air is first filtered out, H2S is heated and converted to SO2, and its glow under ultraviolet light is measured. Some stations may have a cheaper electrochemical sensor, which is less accurate. The exact instrument used at the Atyrau stations has not been confirmed yet.
gazdar.<td>0,2–2 мкг/м³</td><td>Сезімтал адамда: 0.2–2 µg/m³Sensitive people start to notice the smell; at 0.6–6 µg/m³ they start to recognise it (WHO).
gazdar.<td>1–10 мкг/м³</td><td><b>Біздің бекетт: 1–10 µg/m³At our stations: usually 1, at most 10 (14–19 October 2026).
gazdar.<td>7 мкг/м³</td><td>30 минут бойы осыда: 7 µg/m³If it stays above this for 30 minutes, complaints about the smell become more frequent (WHO).
gazdar.<td>150 мкг/м³</td><td>Тәулік бойы — көз: 150 µg/m³Over 24 hours — a limit based on eye irritation (WHO).
gazdar.<td>Ұзақ уақыт әсер етсе — көз тітіркену: With prolonged exposure — eye irritation, headache, fatigue (ATSDR).
gazdar.<td>Иіс сезу жоғалады — иіс бұдан әрі ес: The sense of smell is lost — the smell no longer warns you. Immediately dangerous to life (NIOSH).
gazdar.Біздің бекеттердегі деңгей — иіс сезілет: The level at our stations is a level at which the smell is noticeable; it is thousands of times lower than the harmful levels given by ATSDR.
gazdar.Сау ересек жұмысшыларға, 8 сағаттық ауыс: For healthy adult workers over an 8-hour shift, not for residents:
gazdar.Канада провинциялары: 10 ppm (≈14 000 мк: Canadian provinces: 10 ppm (≈14,000 µg/m³) for 8 hours; ACGIH (Ontario): 1 ppm (≈1400 µg/m³).
gazdar.NIOSH (АҚШ): 10 ppm 10 минутқа; 100 ppm: NIOSH (USA): 10 ppm for 10 minutes; 100 ppm is a level immediately dangerous to life.
gazdar.Тұрғындарға арналған ҚР шегі (8 мкг/м³): The Kazakhstan limit for residents (8 µg/m³) is about 175 times lower than the strictest workplace limit: residents include children, the elderly and the sick, and they breathe this air around the clock.
gazdar.Астмасы барлар — кейбіреуінде тыныс алу: People with asthma — in some, breathing becomes difficult, with possible headache and nausea (ATSDR). There is little research on children.
gazdar.Иіс күшті болса — терезені жабу, ұзақ се: If the smell is strong — close the windows and postpone a long walk.
gazdar.<h2>SO2 — күкірт диоксиді</h2><p class=\:
SO2 — sulfur dioxide

A gas with a sharp smell
gazdar.Түссіз, өткір иісті газ. Көздері: құрамы: A colourless gas with a sharp smell. Sources: burning fuel that contains sulfur, oil refining, CHP plants.
gazdar.Ультракүлгін флуоресценция (АҚШ-та этало: Ultraviolet fluorescence (the reference method in the USA).
gazdar.500 мкг/м³ <span class=\"ppm\">(≈0,19 pp: 500 µg/m³ (≈0.19 ppm) one-time, 50 µg/m³ (≈0.019 ppm) daily (ҚР ДСМ-70). WHO guideline: 40 µg/m³ per day.
gazdar.Тыныс жолдарын тітіркендіреді, қысқа уақ: Irritates the airways and makes breathing harder even after short exposure (EPA).
gazdar.Әдетте 2 мкг/м³, кейде 70–150-ге дейін к: Usually 2 µg/m³, sometimes rising to 70–150 (14–19 October 2026).
gazdar.Қоңыр түсті газ. Көздері: көлік, ЖЭО, өн: A brown gas. Sources: traffic, CHP plants, combustion in industry.
gazdar.Хемилюминесценция: NO озонмен әрекеттеск: Chemiluminescence: the light emitted when NO reacts with ozone is measured; NO2 is first converted to NO.
gazdar.200 мкг/м³ <span class=\"ppm\">(≈0,11 pp: 200 µg/m³ (≈0.11 ppm) one-time, 40 µg/m³ (≈0.021 ppm) daily (ҚР ДСМ-70). WHO (2021): 25 per day, 10 per year.
gazdar.Тыныс жолдарын тітіркендіреді. Қысқа уақ: Irritates the airways. In the short term — cough, wheezing, shortness of breath, especially in asthma. In the long term — it may contribute to developing asthma and increases susceptibility to respiratory infections (EPA).
People with asthma, children, the elderly (EPA).
gazdar.Әдетте 5 мкг/м³, кейде 70–150-ге дейін (: Usually 5 µg/m³, sometimes up to 70–150 (14–19 October 2026).
gazdar.<h2>NO — азот оксиді</h2><p class=\"sub\:
NO — nitric oxide

Quickly turns into NO2 in the air
gazdar.Түссіз газ, жану кезінде пайда болады; а: A colourless gas formed during combustion; it quickly turns into NO2 in the air.
gazdar.Хемилюминесценция (NO2-мен бірге бір құр: Chemiluminescence (in the same instrument as NO2).
gazdar.400 мкг/м³ <span class=\"ppm\">(≈0,33 pp: 400 µg/m³ (≈0.33 ppm) one-time, 60 µg/m³ (≈0.049 ppm) daily (ҚР ДСМ-70).
gazdar.NO тез NO2-ге айналатындықтан, денсаулық: Because NO quickly turns into NO2, the health effects are assessed mainly through NO2 — see the NO2 section.
gazdar.<h2>CO — көміртек оксиді</h2><p class=\":
CO — carbon monoxide

Colourless and odourless, even though it is popularly called “the smelly gas”
gazdar.Түссіз, иіссіз газ — сондықтан адам оны: A colourless, odourless gas — so people cannot sense it. Sources: traffic, combustion, faulty stoves and gas heaters.
gazdar.5000 мкг/м³ <span class=\"ppm\">(≈4,4 pp: 5000 µg/m³ (≈4.4 ppm) one-time, 3000 µg/m³ (≈2.6 ppm) daily (ҚР ДСМ-70). WHO: 4000 per day.
gazdar.Қандағы оттегі мүшелерге (жүрек, ми) аз: Less oxygen reaches the organs (heart, brain) in the blood. At raised outdoor levels, people with heart disease may have chest pain (angina), especially during exertion. At very high levels — dizziness, confusion, loss of consciousness; such levels occur mostly indoors, not outdoors (EPA).
gazdar.Тікелей шығарылмайды — күн сәулесінде NO: It is not emitted directly — it forms in sunlight from NO2 and other substances. It increases in the daytime heat.
gazdar.Ультракүлгін фотометрия — озон ультракүл: Ultraviolet photometry — ozone absorbs ultraviolet light.
gazdar.160 мкг/м³ <span class=\"ppm\">(≈0,082 p: 160 µg/m³ (≈0.082 ppm) one-time, 30 µg/m³ (≈0.015 ppm) daily (ҚР ДСМ-70). WHO: 100 over 8 hours.
gazdar.Жөтел, тамақтың ауыруы, терең тыныс алу: Cough, sore throat, difficulty breathing deeply, pain when inhaling; inflammation of the airways (EPA).
gazdar.Астмасы барлар, балалар, қарттар, далада: People with asthma, children, the elderly, people who spend a lot of time outdoors (EPA).
gazdar.<h2>NH3 — аммиак</h2><p class=\"sub\">Өт:
NH3 — ammonia

A gas with a sharp smell
gazdar.Түссіз, өткір иісті газ. Көздері: тыңайт: A colourless gas with a sharp smell. Sources: fertilisers, livestock farms, some industries.
gazdar.Атырау бекеттеріндегі әдіс әзірге нақтыл: The method used at the Atyrau stations has not been confirmed yet.
gazdar.200 мкг/м³ <span class=\"ppm\">(≈0,29 pp: 200 µg/m³ (≈0.29 ppm) one-time, 40 µg/m³ (≈0.057 ppm) daily (ҚР ДСМ-70).
gazdar.Әдеттегі қоршаған орта деңгейінде зиян т: No harm has been found at ordinary environmental levels. At high levels the eyes, throat and lungs are irritated and there is coughing (ATSDR).
gazdar.<h2>PM10 және PM2,5 — шаң бөлшектері</h2:
PM10 and PM2.5 — dust particles

Not a gas — tiny particles in the air
gazdar.PM10 — диаметрі 10 мкм-ден кіші, PM2,5 —: PM10 are particles smaller than 10 µm in diameter, PM2.5 smaller than 2.5 µm (about 30 times thinner than a hair). Sources: combustion, traffic, construction, dust lifted by the wind.
gazdar.Әдетте бета-сәулелену әдісі (сүзгіге жин: Usually by beta attenuation (how much the dust collected on a filter weakens the radiation) or an optical method (light scattering; cheap, but less accurate at high humidity). The reference method is weighing the filter. The exact instrument used at the Atyrau stations has not been confirmed yet.
gazdar.PM10 — 300 мкг/м³ бір реттік, 60 тәулікт: PM10 — 300 µg/m³ one-time, 60 daily; PM2.5 — 160 one-time, 35 daily (ҚР ДСМ-70). WHO: PM2.5 — 15 per day, 5 per year; PM10 — 45 per day, 15 per year. ppm is not used for particles.
gazdar.Бөлшектер өкпенің терең бөлігіне, кейде: Particles penetrate deep into the lungs and sometimes into the blood. Irritation of the airways, cough, difficulty breathing, worsening asthma, heart rhythm disturbances; people with heart and lung disease face a higher risk of premature death (EPA). WHO: cardiovascular and respiratory disease, cancer.
gazdar.Жүрек немесе өкпе ауруы барлар, балалар,: People with heart or lung disease, children, the elderly (EPA).
gazdar.<b>Бұл медициналық кеңес емес.</b> Деңге: This is not medical advice. The levels and symptoms come from official sources. If you feel worse, call 103 or see a doctor.
